text_block_list.text:
Another hot summer training camp had begun.
As for Daring Heart—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Have you checked our luggage yet?
I bought brand-new camping gear!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
We've leveled up compared to last year.
So we'll hone ourselves in an even harsher environment
to prepare for the Queen Stakes and the Mile Championship!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So! A "the ultimate base"
that can even be used in Antarctica—
choice_data_list: Wait, where do you think you're going!?
Wait, where do you think you're going!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Well, that just goes to show
how incredible the stuff we stocked really is.

After consulting with her, I included mountain training
in the regimen right from the start this year.
Naturally, I obtained special permission for it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I'm all fired up for this year, too! After all, I've got an advisor with me who can help polish my skills even further.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Tact!
For coming along with me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
No. Thank you as well.
After all, I was the one who asked to join.
"Yes, at her own request, Daring Tact will also be joining the mountain training camp this year."
choice_data_list: It's going to be really grueling, are you sure you'll be okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, who are you talking to? Didn't I tell you I'm an adviser?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to survival, she's leagues ahead.
She's what you'd call... totally "hardcore"!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I hold a Special Umamusume Hunting License for traps and nets.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Aside from knowing how to handle encounters with wild beasts,
I also have some knowledge about mountains...
so please let me know if you ever need anything."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't she amazing?
Let's make sure to learn a lot from Tact!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm going to go unpack my bags.
See you later, Tact!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That gear... Heart-san,
are you heading into the mountains again this year?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes! To polish myself even further.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Messiah is... studying?
She still can't train yet, right?
After the Victoria Mile, an injury was discovered on Air Messiah. Just like Cesario, she dedicated herself to rest and recovery.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. After this...
I was thinking of going to see Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"It sounds like she'll be able to mentor a trainee herself starting next year...
I'm planning to ask her all about it."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Already!? So soon?
You must be exceptionally talented... As expected!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Or rather... I kind of sensed it, but
your heart is leaning toward coaching too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Of course,
preparations for my comeback are underway.
However... the exact date remains uncertain...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Then as our next step—
I am thinking that this time,
I should pass on what I inherited from Mother..."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow!
That's amazing!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"To think that the precious feelings you poured into me
at the Shuka Sho... would connect to something
even further ahead!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(...!
Messiah... she looks so beautiful...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Around this time last year,
we didn't even know about Cesario's injury yet—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I really thought we'd all be able
to race together again at the Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And this year...
even Messiah...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right!
Craft and I are still on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: If we clash our hearts together for the sake of Messiah and the others too—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Our youth will never end.
Craft and I... we can just keep it going.

"For that reason, I will sharpen my spirit even further.
—By overcoming the grueling summer training camp."
